newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady as NYMEX futures recover.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady as NYMEX futures recover.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices recovered their early losses on Tuesday to end unchanged, after NYMEX futures staged a rally in the afternoon, traders said.
Premium unleaded barges traded early at $230/$232 fob ARA, but talked higher towards the close, and cif cargoes maintained a $5 premium. The Nov/Dec backwardation was steep at $18.

A Scandinavian trader said weak reforming margins had kept supply tight in October, but a recent recovery in this margin could increase supply next month. "As far as October is concerned the market is pretty tight," she said. -- John Hanley, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8185
